sample-01.limitations: Single static B-mode image without Doppler, elastography, orthogonal views or prior comparison. Measurements are in pixels because the source image carries no pixel-spacing calibration. Interpret with the clinical history, physical examination and complete imaging study.
sample-01.findings: Heterogeneous background echotexture. In the anterior mammary zone there is a solitary oval, parallel (wider-than-tall, ratio 1.65:1), circumscribed hypoechoic mass with fine low-level internal echoes and mild posterior acoustic enhancement, measuring 228 × 138 px on this image. No calcifications, architectural distortion, duct change or skin thickening.
sample-01.impression: Oval, parallel, circumscribed hypoechoic mass, most consistent with a fibroadenoma. BI-RADS 3 – Probably benign (likelihood of malignancy ≤2%).
sample-01.recommendation: Short-interval follow-up ultrasound in 6 months, then at 12 and 24 months to confirm stability. Proceed to US-guided core biopsy if the longest diameter increases by ≥20% within 6 months, if suspicious features develop, or if clinical risk or patient preference warrants tissue diagnosis.

sample-02.limitations: Single static B-mode image without Doppler, elastography, orthogonal views or prior comparison. Measurements are in pixels because the source image carries no pixel-spacing calibration. Interpret with the clinical history, physical examination and complete imaging study.
sample-02.findings: Homogeneous background echotexture – fat. Normal skin and subcutaneous tissue. Fat lobules are separated by thin, intact echogenic Cooper ligaments. No solid or cystic mass, architectural distortion, ductal dilatation or abnormal posterior shadowing.
sample-02.impression: Normal breast ultrasound in the imaged field. BI-RADS 1 – Negative.
sample-02.recommendation: No further imaging required on the basis of this image; continue routine age-appropriate screening. A persistent palpable abnormality still requires clinical evaluation.

sample-03.limitations: Single static B-mode image without Doppler, elastography, orthogonal views or prior comparison. Measurements are in pixels because the source image carries no pixel-spacing calibration. Interpret with the clinical history, physical examination and complete imaging study.
sample-03.findings: Homogeneous background echotexture – fibroglandular, with interspersed fat lobules. A small ill-defined hypoechoic area in the mid-field has the appearance of a normal fat lobule, without mass effect or posterior features. No solid or cystic mass and no architectural distortion.
sample-03.impression: Normal breast ultrasound in the imaged field; mid-field hypoechoic area in keeping with a fat lobule (pseudo-lesion). BI-RADS 1 – Negative.
sample-03.recommendation: No further imaging required on the basis of this image; continue routine screening. If the area corresponds to a palpable concern, confirm in the orthogonal plane.

sample-04.limitations: Single static B-mode image without Doppler, elastography, orthogonal views or prior comparison. Measurements are in pixels because the source image carries no pixel-spacing calibration. Interpret with the clinical history, physical examination and complete imaging study.
sample-04.findings: Heterogeneous background echotexture. In the subcutaneous layer there is an oval, parallel (ratio 1.61:1), circumscribed lesion with a thin echogenic rim, isoechoic to the adjacent subcutaneous fat, measuring 171 × 106 px on this image. No posterior features, calcifications or associated features.
sample-04.impression: Indeterminate. Benign-appearing morphology, but on a single plane a true mass (lipoma, fibroadenoma, intramammary lymph node) cannot be separated from a prominent fat lobule. AI confidence 61.7% (below 70% threshold); final category withheld – BI-RADS 0 pending specialist review (provisional range BI-RADS 2–3).
sample-04.recommendation: Teleradiologist review requested. Obtain orthogonal-plane views, colour Doppler and compression imaging of the lesion, then assign a final BI-RADS category. Keep the case open until the review is signed.

sample-05.limitations: Single static B-mode image without Doppler, elastography, orthogonal views or prior comparison. Measurements are in pixels because the source image carries no pixel-spacing calibration. Interpret with the clinical history, physical examination and complete imaging study.
sample-05.findings: Heterogeneous background echotexture. In the mid mammary zone there is an irregular, near-round (width-to-height 1.23:1), non-circumscribed heterogeneous hypoechoic mass with indistinct margins and a thick echogenic halo, angular margins, posterior acoustic shadowing and architectural distortion of the adjacent Cooper ligaments, measuring 134 × 109 px on this image.
sample-05.impression: Irregular, non-circumscribed (indistinct with echogenic halo, and angular), shadowing hypoechoic mass with architectural distortion, highly suggestive of primary breast carcinoma. BI-RADS 5 – Highly suggestive of malignancy (likelihood ≥95%).
sample-05.recommendation: Urgent referral to a specialist breast unit. US-guided core needle biopsy (14G, ≥3 cores) with clip placement, targeted axillary ultrasound, and bilateral diagnostic mammography; discuss at the breast MDT with histology.
